title: unused-deps-checker configuration
description: Schema for unused-deps.config.json — configures the JS (package.json) and PHP (composer.json) dependency scanners.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for editor IntelliSense.

scan.description: Directories or files walked for import/require specifiers and stylesheet @import/@use references. Relative to the project root.

extensions.description: Code file extensions (including the dot) read for import extraction.

referenceDirs.description: Extra directories scanned for bareword references only (NOT import extraction) — e.g. PHP that enqueues copied npm assets by handle.

referenceFiles.description: Extra root files folded into the reference corpus. Root config files (eslint/postcss/webpack/etc.) and config.*.json are auto-discovered already.

scan.description: PHP source roots searched for `use Namespace\` / `Namespace\` references.

referenceFiles.description: Config files (phpstan.neon, phpcs.xml.dist, rector.php …) where dev tooling is referenced by name. composer.json contributes only its scripts/extra.

ignorePackages.description: Dev-only tooling never reported (e.g. "phpstan/*", "*-stubs"). Platform requirements (php, ext-*) are always skipped automatically.
